title: JBT Marel Introduces the upgraded ModularOven (MOS)
summary: Building on the proven performance of the ModularOven platform, JBT Marel has introduced the upgraded MOS, featuring a range of enhancements focused on reliability, product consistency, serviceability, and operator safety.
body_markdown:
##### Increased personnel safety during maintenance


Operator safety remains a key focus in the latest design update.


A new handheld belt-run-enable safety switch has been added specifically for maintenance activities, providing an additional layer of protection for personnel working on the machine. This improvement helps create a safer maintenance environment while supporting efficient service procedures.
